journal.text: Initial account: $50,000 cash, no holdings. Deploy $42,500 (85%) in a diversified price-momentum basket; retain $7,500 because recent year-end selling and unknown opening gaps argue against full exposure. Review weekly using 20/50-session trends and relative strength, not daily noise; reconsider sooner on closes below GOOGL 296, REGN 735, ROST 174, MNST 72, MU 258, LRCX 155, NVDA 171, LITE 320.
